arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Charles Sims argued the Second Circuit erred in vacating the settlement.
He claimed the registration requirement is not jurisdictional.
He noted Congress granted district courts jurisdiction over copyright actions.
Ms. Anders argued the registration requirement falls between jurisdictional and waivable categories.
